t.1.108.1: Janamejaya said: O mighty one, recount in due order the seniority, from eldest to youngest, of the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, and their names as well.
t.1.108.2: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Duryodhana and Yuyutsu, O king, and likewise Duḥśāsana, Duḥsaha and Duḥśala, Jalasaṃdha, Sama and Saha.
t.1.108.3: Vinda and Anuvinda, Durdharṣa, Subāhu, Duṣpradharṣaṇa, Durmarṣaṇa and Durmukha, Duṣkarṇa, and Karṇa as well.
t.1.108.4: Viviṃśati and Vikarṇa, Jalasaṃdha, Sulocana, Citra and Upacitra, Citrākṣa, Cārucitra, and Śarāsana.
t.1.108.5: Durmada and Duṣpragāha, Vivitsu, Vikaṭa and Sama, Ūrṇanābha and Sunābha, and likewise Nanda and Upanandaka.
t.1.108.6: Senāpati and Suṣeṇa, Kuṇḍodara and Mahodara, Citrabāṇa, Citravarman, Suvarman, and Durvimocana.
t.1.108.8: Ugrāyudha, Bhīmakarman, Kanakāyu, Dṛḍhāyudha, Dṛḍhavarman, Dṛḍhakṣatra, Somakīrti, and Anūdara.
t.1.108.7: Ayobāhu, Mahābāhu, Citrāṅga, Citrakuṇḍala, Bhīmavega, Bhīmabala, Balākī, and Balavardhana.
t.1.108.10: Aparājita, Paṇḍitaka, Viśālākṣa, Durāvara, Dṛḍhahasta and Suhasta, and Vātavega and Suvarcas.
t.1.108.9: Dṛḍhasaṃdha, Jarāsaṃdha, Satyasaṃdha, Sadaḥsuvāk, Ugraśravas, Aśvasena, Senānī and Duṣparājaya.
t.1.108.11: Ādityaketu, Bahvāśin, the two Nāgadanta and Ugrayāyin, Kavacin, Niṣaṅgin, Pāśin, Daṇḍadhāra and Dhanurgraha.
t.1.108.12: Ugra, Bhīmaratha, Vīra, Vīrabāhu, Alolupa, and likewise the three Abhaya, Raudrakarman and Dṛḍharatha.
t.1.108.15: Know, O king, that the order of their births follows the sequence of their names. All of them were atirathas and heroes, all skilled in warfare.
t.1.108.13: Anādhṛṣya, Kuṇḍabhedin, Virāvin, Dīrghalocana, Dīrghabāhu, Mahābāhu, Vyūḍhoru, and Kanakadhvaja.
t.1.108.14: Kuṇḍāśī and Virajas, and Duḥśalā, who makes the number more than a hundred: thus, O king, the hundred and one are declared, and one of them is a daughter.
t.1.108.16: All of them knew the Vedas and were skilled in the treatises on kingship; all were versed in the arts of social intercourse, and they shone with learning and noble birth.
t.1.108.17: And then, O lord of the earth, when the time had come, Dhṛtarāṣṭra, after due consideration, had suitable wives taken for all of them according to the rites.
t.1.108.18: Then, O Bhārata, at the proper time, the king gave Duḥśalā to Jayadratha, the king of Sindhu, with the consent of Saubala.
